conventions.end_times: The posters print start times only; each activity's end time equals the next activity's start (or the start of a printed BREAK / end of the day at 24:00).
conventions.crossing_midnight: Sets that continue past midnight appear once, dated on their start day, with crosses_midnight = true.
conventions.breaks: BREAK blocks are not listed as activities; they only bound end times.
conventions.day_numbering: Day 0 = Tue 14 Jul (Welcome Party, exclusive to shuttle/bus guests), Day 1 = Wed 15 Jul … Day 7 = Tue 21 Jul.

sources: Official ZNA Gathering 2026 timetable posters (June 2026 final version) — primary source for names, times and set types
znagathering.com official programme pages (Zambu Temple, The Peninsula, Market) — used to verify artist names and set types
verification_notes: All five timetable posters (Zambu Temple, The Peninsula, Market, Zenbuspace Classes, Zenbuspace Workshops) were verified against the original 1080x1080 images at pixel level on 2026-07-06; every block boundary was located by background-tint transition analysis and cross-checked against printed time labels.
Set-type subtitles on The Peninsula were disambiguated by measured subtitle ink/width against same-poster references (DJ SET vs PRODUCER SET).

Poster vs official-website line-up differences (poster, final June 2026 version, is authoritative): poster lists Larsik (site: Chema Escudero) and Andrew Sigil (site: Qses); the site also lists Merr0w, who does not appear on the final posters.
Poster vs site name spellings: Ree-K (site: Ree.K / Ree K), Anaïs Linn (site: Anaïs-Lin), Sancha Meiso Chaya (site: Sancho Meiso Chaya), Gagarin (site: Gagarin Project), E-SKO (site: E~SKO).

Poster vs site set-type differences are flagged in the relevant entries' notes (David Maurette ft. Irina Mikhailova, Irina Mikhailova, Process vs Aether, Gabi Von Dub, Angular Momentum, Holeg Spies, Federico Baltimore, Ludvig & Stelar).

descriptions.coverage: Every music activity carries a short 'description' summarizing the artist text on the official znagathering.com programme page for that stage (info_source). Descriptions are concise summaries, not verbatim copies of the site text; open info_source to read the full official write-up.
descriptions.zenbuspace: The official website has not published programme/facilitator texts for Zenbuspace (Classes & Workshops), so those entries have description = null; names, presenters and times come from the official timetable posters.
descriptions.no_official_text: A few acts have no official description (marked in their 'note'): Larsik, SURPRISE!!, LSD All Stars, nois'R'us, Andrew Sigil, plus Benji Vaughan's Peninsula set and Process vs Aether (marked TBA/TBD on the site).
descriptions.verification: All descriptions were audited line-by-line against the official programme pages; claims that could not be anchored to the site text were removed or generalized (audit pass of 2026-07-06).

activities.note: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

activities.name: Virtuart
activities.note: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.
activities.description: French artist of the Suntrip family; immersive journeys and finely crafted melodies drawing on a rich 90s body of work.

activities.name: Max Lanfranconi
activities.note: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.
activities.description: The Etnica/Pleiadians/Crop Circles legend in a rare intimate setting — epic ZambuTemple energy scaled to the Welcome Party.

activities.name: GoAstral
activities.note: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.
activities.description: Brazilian project (Ovnimoon Rec) of deep psychedelic storytelling and hypnotic layers, moving between cosmic intensity and spiritual elevation.

activities.name: Sharon
activities.note: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.
activities.description: Sharon Haiat (StoneAge Records, Israel), Goa-classics curator since 2017; fluid story-driven sets with seamless mixing — fresh from Goa Guardians 2022.

activities.name: Your wild and wise dancing together
David Maurette ft. Irina Mikhailova

activities.name: The Fundamentals of Shamanic Energy Healing
Etnica in Dub
activities.description: The Goa-defining Italian project reveals its dub dimension: spacious basslines, hypnotic echoes and downtempo grooves where classic psychedelia slows into warm fluidity.

activities.name: Psara
activities.description: From 1987 new-wave booths through Goa trance, philosophy and her Mysticeti project — a genre-rich journey by ZNA's veteran resident, on the chill floor.

activities.name: Cosmos Within - Embodied Astrology (Sun and Mercury in Cancer)
Henriq
activities.description: Half of Zen Baboon and a Boom Festival music curator; cosmic border-free journeys from a producer with releases across many labels.

activities.name: Ukiro
activities.description: Swedish DJ and collector in the Goa movement since 1994, famed for one of the deepest record collections and encyclopedic genre knowledge; he performs only rarely, making this Goa Guardians set a real treat.

activities.name: Chanting to the 7 Directions (Ancestral Trance) — EAST (Fire)
Gabi Von Dub
activities.description: 26+ years on the decks and a ZNA resident since day one (also releasing as Augen); long, whimsical sessions moving between intensity and introspection.
activities.note: Poster subtitle: DJ Set; the official site lists a producer set.

activities.name: Psara
activities.description: Portuguese DJ with ~30 years in the scene and a ZNA resident since 2012 (PsyHarmonics); her Goa Guardians set spotlights the foundational retro classics of the 90s.

activities.name: Mathew Jonson presents Freedom Engine
activities.note: Start printed as 00:01 on the poster; exclusive 4-hour Freedom Engine live set.
activities.description: Visionary Canadian live artist (Cobblestone Jazz, Wagon Repair) in an exclusive 4-hour Freedom Engine live set — analog warmth, melodic depth and hypnotic floor-focused rhythms.

activities.name: Eden
activities.description: Israeli DJ from the DAT Universe collective, two decades into Goa music; brings a hypnotic, lyrical, strongly psychedelic vibe rooted in classic Goa.

activities.name: Angular Momentum
activities.description: Textured grooves, polyrhythms and hypnotic, techno-tinged ambient soundscapes in a curated late-night DJ set.
activities.note: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

activities.name: Dark El Kante
activities.description: Jorge Bazan (Spain), leading Suomisaundi figure and head of the non-profit Random Records; deep, expansive, trance-inducing sets since the late 90s.

activities.name: Dr. Vagator
activities.description: French underground Goa ambassador (site: 'Doctor Vagator') with a huge Digital Audio Tape archive, still played on his historic DAT machines — beloved and obscure treasures alike.

activities.name: Sjama'dan
activities.description: Belgian DJ (DAT Universe) blending organic, hypnotic and psychedelic atmospheres with seamless mixing and storytelling.

activities.name: Larsik
activities.note: Name as printed on the timetable; the official Goa Guardians web page lists Chema Escudero instead (late line-up change). No description on the official site (the Goa Guardians web page lists Chema Escudero instead).

activities.name: Dezoncondor
activities.description: Deep psychedelic ambience, immersive drones and slow-moving sonic environments — cinematic psyambient storytelling designed for presence and mental expansion.

activities.name: Emico Amore
activities.description: Japanese DJ (DAT Universe) in the Goa movement since 1993, from Tokyo's underground to Goa's beaches; powerful narrative sets steeped in the Goa spirit.

activities.name: The Council of All Beings - Speaking on Behalf of the More-Than-Human World
X_T.i.g.m.a.
activities.description: Pedro Dias, Quest4Goa co-founder (1999) and long-time ZNA collaborator; genre-fluid selections with a subtle experimental edge.

activities.name: Jordan
activities.description: Greek renegade DJ at the helm of Goa parties since 1995 and producer in Disco Hooligans, Outer World Elements and TMC; deep roots in the London and global Goa scene.

activities.name: Zen Baboon
activities.description: Daniel Rosado and Henrique Palhavã (live since Boom 2006); Portuguese downtempo royalty with releases on major underground labels.

activities.name: Simon Blue Room
activities.description: Simon Ghahary, the visionary behind the iconic Blue Room Released label of the 90s; a special appearance playing classics and unknown treasures from the label's archive.

activities.name: Osteopathic Body Opening – Breath, Movement & Connection
Irina Mikhailova
activities.description: Internationally touring vocalist (Kaya Project) whose voice appears across many artists' records and soundtracks — an entrancing solo live set of song and electronics.
activities.note: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site describes this as a live set.

activities.name: Atmos
activities.description: Tomasz (Spiral Trax, Sweden), a ZNA family member since 2013; masterful, slowly-unfolding progressive psychedelic trance opening the Retro Universe journey.

activities.name: Sérgio Walgood
activities.description: Composer, live artist and host/curator of The Peninsula stage; immersive sonic storytelling bridging psychedelic downtempo, ritual ambience and deep hypnotic groove.

activities.name: Ololiuqui
activities.description: Volker König's legendary Spirit Zone project in his Retro-Futuristic premiere; a ride designed to carry the floor from progressive grooves into raw Aussie-style psychedelia.

activities.name: Chanting to the 7 Directions (Ancestral Trance) — SOUTH (Earth)
Balancé
activities.description: Pedro Monteiro (Portugal), crafting psychedelic chillout since 2007; emotional soundscapes exploring rhythm, movement and balance.

activities.name: Alphanaut
activities.description: Matthew Hall & Murray Antill, a hidden gem of the 90s Australian psychedelic wave; abstract, intense and playfully delirious night music — their first time live at ZNA.

activities.name: Psyko Disko vs Spies
activities.description: Goa pioneer Fred Disko (nearly 80!), who bridged the 60s–70s Goa rock parties into early Goa trance, joins sound alchemist Holeg Spies for a 3-hour odyssey to the scene's roots.

activities.name: Gagarin
activities.description: Founder of psybient.org; long, mind-expanding sets moving from midtempo ethnic textures to trippy, high-energy dance, inspired by conscious living.
activities.note: Poster name: Gagarin; full official name: Gagarin Project.

activities.name: Germinator vs Drop & Dash
activities.description: Original Drop & Dash duo Jan Richter and Frederik (Sweden), pioneers of early psytrance, also revisiting their Germinator project — raw early-90s sound with unreleased archive material.

activities.name: U.X. vs Syb Unity Nettwerk
activities.description: Kris Kylven's twin legends U.X. (Ultimate Xperience) and Syb Unity Nettwerk; a tailor-made voyage from the night's darker shades up into radiant light.

activities.name: Solitare
activities.description: Mark Ainley (Canada), a walking library of rare old-school Goa; years of digging and preservation distilled into a story-driven morning selection.

activities.name: Ree-K vs Domino
activities.description: First-ever back-to-back between two pioneering women of the scene — Japan's Ree-K (Matsuri) and Domino (Equinox), a longtime friend of the Zambu family.

activities.name: Oliver Jones
activities.description: One half of Reefer Decree; a warm, hypnotic downtempo session of flowing grooves, rich ambient layers and time-dissolving psychedelic storytelling.

activities.name: The memory of the water: Vessel of ancestral tradition
Nick Barber (DOOF)
activities.note: Nick Barber = DOOF; exclusive 2-hour downtempo producer set.
activities.description: DOOF's downtempo face: an exclusive 2-hour producer set of renowned and rare downtempo tracks, re-adapted with ZNA's engineers for modern systems.

activities.name: Cyan
activities.description: Greek 90s acid-trance project reunited in the studio especially for ZNA; euphoric, high-pitched melodic/Nitzhonot-style trance re-polished for the Temple's sound system.

activities.name: O Pulsar da Essência: Som, Corpo e Presença
Talk: Merging Science with the Sacred: The Neuroscience of Collective Trance
Holeg Spies
activities.description: French composer and sonic explorer (film scoring, musique concrète); a deep journey through his album 'Brave New World' — ambient passages and cinematic psychedelia.
activities.note: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

activities.name: One Man Game vs Mystica
activities.description: Avi Pe'er and Yossef Master reunite on stage after 30 years, spanning One Man Game and its evolution Mystica; rolling basslines and uplifting afternoon melodies.

activities.name: Synergy Dub
activities.description: Gabriel Le Mar and DJ Robin Triskele's DJ/live dub project (Liquid Sound Design), joined for ZNA 2026 by Groovetitan; future dub grooves with live overdubs.

activities.name: Yahel
activities.description: Israeli creator of timeless euphoric, emotional Goa anthems of the 90s (Shiva Space Technology); the melodic closing of a near-24-hour marathon.

activities.name: Your wild and wise dancing together
Bill Robin & Maya Wada
activities.description: South London acid-house veteran (playing since 1988, Harthouse releases, early dubstep) with Maya Wada's intuitive ambient textures — dance culture meets meditative space.

activities.name: The Future Shape Of Sound: The Blue Room Story
LSD All Stars
activities.note: Poster subtitle: Producer Set. No description published on the official site.

activities.name: Awaken Your Intuition: Inversions, Breath, and Inner Listening
Tecnica
activities.note: Special sunset DJ set (Etnica side project).
activities.description: Etnica's hypnotic groovier side project (Max Lanfranconi & Maurizio Begotti) in a special exclusive sunset DJ set of slow progressive melodic grooves.

activities.name: Youth in Dub
activities.description: Martin Glover — Killing Joke bassist, Grammy-winning producer and founder of the Dragonfly and Liquid Sound Design labels — in deep dub mode.

activities.name: The Future Ancestor – From Lineage To Legacy
Reefer Decree
activities.description: Defining Scandinavian project of Daniel Jiwook and Oliver Bierlich (Iboga); groove- and bassline-driven hypnotic psychedelia opening a 24-hour journey.

activities.name: Chanting to the 7 Directions (Ancestral Trance) — WEST (Water)
Psara
activities.description: Sara Marrecas — dancer first, DJ second — journeying through the slower, deeper side of psychedelic dance techno and progressive lysergic sounds.

activities.name: M.O.S.

activities.name: Alien Rain
activities.description: Berlin's Milton Bradley, acid-techno master and lifelong digger, guest-playing psychedelic dance music from 1988–1993: EBM, proto-Goa, acid house and Belgian beat.

activities.name: Simon Blue Room
activities.description: The Blue Room Released visionary shares chill-side classics and unknown treasures from the legendary label's archive.

activities.name: Eat Static
activities.description: Merv Pepler (ex-Ozric Tentacles), running Eat Static since 1989; a tailored 'Merv vs. the Machines' performance dug from his personal archives of sci-fi psychedelia.

activities.name: Ubar Tmar

activities.name: Andrew Till

activities.name: Masaray

activities.name: Floating Machine

activities.name: Gabi von Dub

Extrawelt

activities.name: Benji Vaughan

activities.name: Biohacking & Emotional Health: Ancient Tools for Modern Nervous Systems
Cheers
activities.description: Vinyl digger devoted to proto-Goa, new beat and early trance; lovingly restored hidden gems bridging nostalgic sounds and a modern dancefloor pulse.

activities.name: Mike Stellar
activities.description: Angolan-born refined selector rescuing rare gems into progressive folktronic downtempo — European electronics meeting African and Brazilian beats.

activities.name: Dado vs Dino Psaras
activities.description: Frédéric Holyszewski (Deedrah/Transwave/Synthetic…) and Dino Psaras craft an exclusive journey built solely from their 1990s material — released anthems and hidden gems alike.

activities.name: The Origin of the Universe - A Tantric Perspective
Robert Leiner
activities.note: The Source Experience — extended 4-hour set (poster block spans 20:00–24:00).
activities.description: The Source Experience — a hidden architect of 90s electronics (R&S Records, 'Visions of the Past'); hypnotic analog techno/trance/acid/ambient journeys.

activities.name: Chanting to the 7 Directions (Ancestral Trance) — ABOVE (Cosmic Mind)
Cosmosis
activities.description: Bill Halsey, former professional guitarist turned Goa legend, revealing his chill language: warm rhythms, psychedelic downtempo textures and effortless groove.

activities.name: SURPRISE!!
activities.note: Unannounced surprise act. Unannounced surprise act — no description by design.

activities.name: Indra
activities.description: Croatian DJane and Ecstatic Dance Croatia founder; floating mystical atmospheres, deep dub bass and ethnic organic elements in story-driven sets (Boom, MoDem, Psy-Fi).

activities.name: Earl Peal
activities.description: Estonian Johannes Eriste, drummer-turned-producer collaborating with Alex Tolstey (remixes for Extrawelt, X-Dream, Holeg Spies); fresh lysergic indie techno with a psychedelic twist.

activities.name: Nouveau Shamanique
activities.description: New-generation live act (Suntrip) performing 100% on hardware, exactly like in the golden 90s — rhythmic, experimental, deeply psychedelic Goa and acid trance.

activities.name: Alex Tolstey
activities.description: Boshke Beats founder (300+ releases), X-Dream art director and the Market Stage curator; rare selections, lysergic house and psychedelic techno in sophisticated hypnotic flow.

activities.name: Andrew Sigil
activities.note: Name confirmed as printed on the poster; not listed on the official Peninsula web page (the site lists Qses, who does not appear on the final poster).

activities.name: Moon Beasts
activities.description: The minds behind Ephedra and Proxeeus combined: darker touches, uplifting melodies and a generous layer of acid/TB-303 on top.

activities.name: Proxeeus
activities.description: French TB-303 acid-trance explorer (Global Sect / Goa Madness) heading into darker territories — a brain-inverting night experience.

activities.name: Triple Distilled Disco Squad
activities.description: Alex Tolstey's unpredictable alter ego: spontaneous disco-techno from beyond — no plan, no preparation, pure feel and flow across disco, techno, trance and electro.

activities.name: Goaacen
activities.description: Leading Portuguese Goa-trance DJ (Suntrip/604 Productions) with a taste for slightly darker Goa territories.

activities.name: Mini Spacer
activities.description: Morning-trance master (Suntrip) whose melodic, magical, slightly melancholic Goa beams the floor straight back to 90s beach sunrises — the golden morning slot.

activities.name: Artifact303
activities.description: Romanian Zsolt Peter, an instant legend since his 2011 Suntrip debut; modern production, magical Goa melodies and masterful storytelling under the trees.

activities.name: Daniel Sol
activities.description: Madrid music lover and co-founder of Ensancha el Alma Records (psychill/downtempo); emotional journeys through jazz, soul, world and electronica textures.

activities.name: The Inner Sunrise – A Journey Into Presence and Power
Antidot & DICA
activities.description: French duo mixing Goa, acid, hard-trance and techno on a full hardware live setup — energetic, high-BPM, original and fun (Suntrip).

activities.name: Organica
activities.description: Obsessive record digger exploring the underground since 1997; hypnotic basslines, tribal rhythms and elevated melodic atmospheres honouring old-school Goa roots.

activities.name: Spiral Breath – Awakening the Life Force "Earth & Air"
Skizologic vs Filteria
activities.description: The master of modern melodic uplifting Goa teams up with Skizologic's groovy acidic style — some tracks released, the rest premiered on the floor.

activities.name: Ultravibe
activities.description: Filteria (today's Goa legend) together with Cosmosis (90s legend): Goa trance with a modern edge for dust-stomping.

activities.name: Federico Baltimore
activities.description: Dado's (Transwave/Deedrah/Synthetic) chillout alter ego since 'Beleza!' (2007); emotional, cinematic downtempo blending ambient, lounge and classical influences.
activities.note: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

activities.name: James Monro
activities.note: Extended 8-hour closing set of the Market stage (16:00–24:00).
activities.description: Early-UK-trance pioneer with hundreds of releases and one of the inspirations behind the Market Stage; an extended closing journey of progressive techno and hypnotic psychedelic house.

activities.name: Hypnoxock
activities.description: Victor (Spain, Suntrip), a creative all-rounder back to his big love Goa-trance; funky, unconventional psychedelia from melodic morning vibes to acid material.

activities.name: GUMI
activities.description: Maor Hasbani (Tel Aviv, also Skizologic); elastic downtempo fusing bold basslines, tribal rhythms and ethnic melodies with analog warmth (Boom, Rainbow Serpent).

activities.name: Ephedra
activities.description: Belgian producer with some 20 years of Goa productions and head of the Goa Madness label; beautiful melodies, euphoric harmonies and bouncy modern kicks.

activities.name: Kukan dub Lagan
activities.description: Itay's groovy fusion of dub, world music, downtempo and funk — warm, bass-heavy, soulful music made to put smiles on faces.

activities.name: Anoebis
activities.description: Suntrip Records label boss with one of the world's biggest Goa collections; back after beating leukemia to close the festival with melodic bliss.

activities.name: Chanting to the 7 Directions (Ancestral Trance) — CENTER (Heart)
OTT
activities.description: Legendary dub-electronics producer/engineer (worked with Brian Eno, The Orb, Youth); creator of 'Hallucinogen in Dub', 'Blumenkraft' and 'Skylon' — closing the Peninsula.
